references.text: Joshua's conquest of Jericho, which the Gibeonites had heard about
Joshua's conquest of Ai, which the Gibeonites had heard about
Rahab tells how the peoples in the land had heard of Israel's victories and were afraid
Other kings in the land also heard about Joshua's victories and gathered to fight against Israel
Adoni-Zedek in Jerusalem heard what Joshua had done to Jericho and Ai, and about the Gibeonites' peace treaty
Gibeon was the only city that made peace with Israel; the others were conquered by war
Moses' prophecy that the peoples would hear of Israel and fear them
